source: config/strategies/reference-300-strategies.txt (Category 1); the hash-bound original text is joined by reference_id at run time
translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15) of the catalogue pseudo-code into stock-gplm.strategy-dsl.v1. EXACT = literal mapping of the pseudo-code; APPROXIMATION = documented interpretation (see assumptions). Exit rules are not in the catalogue; they come from the named exit profile.

strategies.name: Triple EMA Ribbon Fan-Out (5/8/13 EMA)
strategies.entry: ema(close, 5) > ema(close, 8) > ema(close, 13) and rising(ema(close, 5) - ema(close, 13), 3)
assumptions: 'expanding over 3 bars' = the EMA5-EMA13 spread rose on each of the last 3 bars

strategies.name: Minervini Trend Template (Stage 2)
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 50) > sma(close, 150) > sma(close, 200) and sma(close, 200) > sma(close, 200)[20] and close >= 1.3 * lowest(low, 252)

strategies.name: MACD Histogram Slingshot
strategies.entry: macd(close) > 0 and all_of(macd_hist(close) < 0, 3)[1] and macd_hist(close) > macd_hist(close)[1]

strategies.name: Impulse MACD Surge
strategies.entry: macd(close) > macd_signal(close) and macd(close) > sma(macd(close), 20) + $k * stdev(macd(close), 20)
assumptions: Upper_StdDev_Band(MACD, 20) = SMA(MACD,20) + k x StdDev(MACD,20); k not given, default 2

strategies.name: Supertrend Bullish Flip
assumptions: 'Close crosses above Supertrend' is the bar where the Supertrend direction flips from -1 to +1

strategies.name: Ichimoku Kumo Cloud Breakout
strategies.entry: close > max(senkou_a(9, 26, 26), senkou_b(52, 26)) and close > close[26]
assumptions: Chikou_Span > Close[t-26] is equivalent to Close[t] > Close[t-26]
cloud spans are those plotted at bar t (computed from data 26 bars earlier)

strategies.name: Ichimoku TK Cross above Cloud
strategies.entry: cross_above(midpoint(9), midpoint(26)) and close > max(senkou_a(9, 26, 26), senkou_b(52, 26))

strategies.name: Kijun-Sen Trend Bounce
strategies.entry: close > max(senkou_a(9, 26, 26), senkou_b(52, 26)) and low <= midpoint(26) and close > midpoint(26)

strategies.name: 52-Week High Breakout (weekly bars)
assumptions: 52 weekly bars = 52 weeks; volume average over 20 weeks

strategies.name: All-Time High Blue Sky Breakout
assumptions: All_Time_High is bounded by the start of local data (2022-10-31 for most symbols); signals start after 250 bars of history so the 'ATH' is at least a ~1-year high. This is NOT a true lifetime high.

strategies.name: Darvas Box Top Breakout
assumptions: Box_High = highest high of the prior N bars; 'held unbreached for >= 5 bars' = that level was already the N-bar high 5 bars earlier

strategies.name: First Pullback to 20 EMA after Breakout
strategies.entry: any_of(high > highest(high, 252)[1], 5)[1] and low <= ema(close, 20) * 1.01 and close > open
assumptions: 'High[t-5..t-1] > High_52W' = at least one of the previous 5 bars made a new 252-bar high

strategies.name: Schaff Trend Cycle Acceleration
assumptions: STC(10, 23, 50) read as cycle=10, fast=23, slow=50

strategies.name: GMMA Expansion
strategies.entry: min(ema(close, 3), ema(close, 5), ema(close, 8), ema(close, 10), ema(close, 12), ema(close, 15)) > max(ema(close, 30), ema(close, 35), ema(close, 40), ema(close, 45), ema(close, 50), ema(close, 60)) and (min(ema(close, 3), ema(close, 5), ema(close, 8), ema(close, 10), ema(close, 12), ema(close, 15)) - max(ema(close, 30), ema(close, 35), ema(close, 40), ema(close, 45), ema(close, 50), ema(close, 60))) > (min(ema(close, 3), ema(close, 5), ema(close, 8), ema(close, 10), ema(close, 12), ema(close, 15)) - max(ema(close, 30), ema(close, 35), ema(close, 40), ema(close, 45), ema(close, 50), ema(close, 60)))[1]
assumptions: 'spread widening' = (min short EMA - max long EMA) greater than on the previous bar

strategies.name: DPO Cycle Thrust
assumptions: Causal DPO = Close[t-(n/2+1)] - SMA(Close, n); the classic centred DPO uses future bars

strategies.name: 3-Bar Momentum Ignition
strategies.entry: close > high[1] and (high - low) > 2 * atr(14) and (close - low) / (high - low) >= 0.8
